violation_type.title: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths (26 TAC §747.3301(2))
violation_type.short_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation admitted that a child was not properly wiped on two occasions before being sent home.

finding_variants.text: The operation admitted that a child was not properly wiped on two occasions before being sent home.
Individual cloths/wipes are not being used to clean children during diaper changes. Children are being splashed with water from the sink while lying on the counter top.
